description: Reported behaviour /  Issue: 24V AUX Drops to 0V Under Load

additional_info.subject: SiCharge D - Nein Hatvor - Y2/R2312900727013 - 24V AUX Drops to 0V Under Load
additional_info.body:
Helow Siemens Support,
We are experiencing an issue in SiCharge D charger D charger installed at DeleK Nein HaTavor
(serial number Y2/R2312900727013).
Issue Summary
the 24V auxiliary supply feeding the LED-Emotion lighting controller shows the following behavior:
-Terminal voltage is 24-25V With no load.
-When connecting the LED-Emotion controller (even a new unit), the voltage
drops
immediately
to 0-2v.
-same behavior occurs even when all LED output channels are disconnected.
-DMX signal from module KF9 is present and verified.
Important Note
We Have replaced the KF15/LED-Emotion controller with a complete ner unit,
and the exact same behavior persists.
We kindly request your assistance in dignosing and resolving this issue.
Thank you in advance for support.
Best regards,
AhmedHaeim
​
​
​
​
Ahmed Haim
Electrician
*5619
|
ahmedh@zen-ev.com

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0464873-DC/Si-D/IL-[Y2 / R2 312900727013] 24V AUX Drops to 0V Under Load CRM:00472000501
additional_info.body:
Hello Joao,
Initially, we replaced the KF15 with a new one, but that didn't help either.
Then we tried replacing all the electronic fuses from FC12-FC17, but unfortunately that didn't work either.
Please note that I attached a picture in the previous email where all the indicator lights of the electronic fuses are on and working.
We didn't try to connect the KF15 without being connected to the ecog.
I have KF11 components in stock, could you please explain to me before we try to replace a component how I configure it according to the latest charging station version?
If I'm doing it all over again, it won't work, I'd be happy to help with the configuration instructions accordingly.
Thanks in advance,
Orel
